content.text: I have investigated all responsive locations. No supply-exclusivity or sole-source obligation exists.

input.quote: This procedure shall be the sole and exclusive remedy for any dispute which may arise under this Agreement between or among the Parties.
input.rationale: This is an APCN 2 consortium construction and ownership agreement, and it imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on us. Targeted searches for "exclusive", "exclusivity", "sole supplier/source", "requirements from", "shall not procure/purchase from any third party", "shall only", "solely" and "other cable systems" returned no sourcing restriction. The only "exclusive" hit (Paragraph 27.1, p0262) is the sole-and-exclusive dispute-resolution remedy, which is a forum/remedy mechanic reviewed under GOVLAW, not exclusive dealing. The capacity provisions in Paragraph 12 are acquisition and use mechanics (Paragraph 12.1 limits use of APCN 2 capacity to carriers; Paragraph 12.27 expressly permits a Party to sell sub-STM-1 capacity "at any time"), and nothing bars us from acquiring or providing capacity on other systems or from other suppliers. Paragraph 17.4 runs in our favour by prohibiting Terminal Parties from impeding Direct Access. The rule therefore sits at the preferred position: we retain full freedom to buy from other suppliers, so no redline is warranted.
